method.definition: First compilation on a fresh engine in a loaded process; warm compilation of the same boxed expression with a new compile target each time. Setup, GC, module import and result validation are untimed. No kernel execution timings.
method.order: Alternating process order; accept three processes per tree and workload; exclude competing CLI tests/typechecks/builds or other observed processes at >=70% CPU, sampled every 0.5 seconds. Idle language-server presence alone is not a conflict.
method.limitations: Source via tsx, not production bundles. Ordinary desktop activity remains. Short samples do not establish small speed differences; no commit-level attribution is inferred. Broad-process attempts are excluded and retained.

compilerCodeLines.definition: Nonblank .ts lines not beginning // or *, matching the contraction-plan survey convention.

postReviewCorrections: Removed ignored hideValues option; counts now bracket each compile before result validation and are named instance-method lookups. Rechecked every control and count; values and emitted-source digests remain unchanged. Timed statements were unchanged; archived timingHarness and its SHA identify the measured script.
workCountMetric: Calls through the ce.lookupDefinition instance method during compilation only. Module-local lookup functions bypass it; this is a work proxy, not a complete count of engine lookups. Validation is outside each counted interval.
